title: A Welcome fanout with the hub's ratchet tree can exceed MAX_BODY_LEN
description: Found by mimid-e64f.18 (2026-11-21). maxMlsObjectSize (4 MiB - 64 KiB) bounds what a client sends, but a Welcome's FanoutMessage carries the hub's own ratchet tree (crates/mimid-server/src/hub/update.rs), not anything from the client's request. If a client's Commit carries no tree (e.g. tree by reference), the Welcome fanout body is the Welcome plus the whole tree and can exceed MAX_BODY_LEN (4 MiB) however small the object limit is. Options: send the tree out of band (ratchet tree options), refuse at the hub with a clear error, or bound the group size. Needs a decision before large rooms.
close_reason: Fixed in b765ccd (branch welcome-tree): oversized Welcomes go with RatchetTreeOption distributionService and joiners fetch the tree by groupInfo with their leaf key; if neither fits, the Commit is refused. Decision mimid-1wgh.81; spec gaps mimid-3hoq.
